body.prompt: Rewrite the sentence beginning with 'If': I don't have a bike, so I can't ride to school.
acceptable: If I had a bike, I would ride to school.
If I had a bike, I would be able to ride to school.

_provenance.cefr_reasoning: The item tests the second conditional (If + past simple, would/could + base verb), a grammar point typically introduced at B1. Vocabulary is simple and the transformation is a single-clause rewrite, matching B1 expectations.

blind_solve_answer.answer: If I had a bike, I could ride to school.

explanation.explanation_en: This is a second conditional sentence. It describes an unreal present situation, so we use 'If + past simple' in the if-clause and 'would/could + base verb' in the main clause. 'Could' expresses ability in the imagined situation.
explanation.explanation_vi: Đây là câu điều kiện loại hai, diễn tả tình huống không có thật ở hiện tại. Mệnh đề 'if' dùng thì quá khứ đơn ('If I had a bike'), mệnh đề chính dùng 'would/could + động từ nguyên mẫu' ('I could ride to school'). 'Could' diễn tả khả năng trong tình huống giả định.

body.correct_answer: If I had a bike, I could ride to school.

body.prompt: If I ___ more time this weekend, I would finish painting the kitchen.

_provenance.cefr_reasoning: The item tests the second conditional (unreal present), which is a standard B1 grammar point: past simple in the if-clause with 'would + base verb' in the main clause. The vocabulary is everyday and the distractors (present simple, will, would have) are plausible but clearly distinguishable at this level.

explanation.explanation_en: This is a second conditional sentence describing an unreal or hypothetical situation in the present. After 'If' in the if-clause, we use the past simple ('had'), and the main clause uses 'would + base verb' ('would finish').
explanation.explanation_vi: Đây là câu điều kiện loại hai diễn tả tình huống không có thật hoặc giả định ở hiện tại. Mệnh đề 'If' dùng thì quá khứ đơn ('had'), còn mệnh đề chính dùng 'would + động từ nguyên mẫu' ('would finish').

body.prompt: If I ___ more time, I would learn to play the guitar.

_provenance.cefr_reasoning: The item tests the second conditional (If + past simple, would + verb), a grammar structure typically introduced and consolidated at B1 level. The vocabulary is simple and the sentence is short, but the hypothetical/unreal meaning goes beyond A2's simple real conditionals, making B1 the best fit.

explanation.explanation_en: This is a second conditional sentence (If + past simple, would + verb), used for imaginary or unlikely situations in the present or future. So we use 'had', not 'have' or 'will have'.
explanation.explanation_vi: Đây là câu điều kiện loại 2 (If + quá khứ đơn, would + động từ), dùng để nói về tình huống giả định hoặc khó xảy ra ở hiện tại hoặc tương lai. Vì vậy ta dùng 'had', không dùng 'have' hay 'will have'.

body.prompt: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home and watch a film.

_provenance.cefr_reasoning: The item tests the second conditional (If + past simple, would + base verb), a structure typically introduced and consolidated at B1. Vocabulary is simple and the sentence is short and clear, making it appropriate for B1 learners reviewing foundational grammar.

explanation.explanation_en: This is a first conditional about a real future possibility: If + present simple, will + base verb. The if-clause uses the present simple 'rains', not 'will rain'.
explanation.explanation_vi: Đây là câu điều kiện loại 1 về khả năng có thật trong tương lai: If + hiện tại đơn, will + động từ nguyên mẫu. Mệnh đề if dùng hiện tại đơn 'rains', không dùng 'will rain'.

examples.note: Zero conditional: a general truth. Both clauses use the present simple; 'if' can be replaced by 'when' with the same meaning.
examples.text: If you mix red and blue, you get purple.

examples.note: First conditional: a real future possibility. Present simple in the if-clause, 'will + verb' in the result clause.
examples.text: If it rains this afternoon, I will take an umbrella.

examples.note: Second conditional: an unreal/hypothetical situation. Past simple in the if-clause, 'would + verb' in the result clause; 'were' is used for all persons.
examples.text: If I were rich, I would travel around the world.

body.objective: Understand the formation and core uses of the zero, first, and second conditionals in order to talk about real possibilities, general truths, and hypothetical situations accurately.

explanation.en: Conditionals are sentences with an 'if-clause' (the condition) and a main clause (the result). There are three main types at this level. (1) The ZERO conditional describes general truths and habits: If + present simple, present simple (e.g., 'If you heat ice, it melts.'). Both clauses use the present simple because the result always happens. (2) The FIRST conditional describes real future possibilities: If + present simple, will + base verb (e.g., 'If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.'). The if-clause uses the present simple, NOT 'will'. (3) The SECOND conditional describes hypothetical or unlikely present/future situations: If + past simple, would + base verb (e.g., 'If I had more time, I would travel.'). The past simple here shows unreality, not past time. You can swap the clause order ('We will stay home if it rains'), but keep the comma only when the if-clause comes first. Common variants: 'unless' = 'if not' ('Unless you hurry, you'll be late'), and 'were' is often used for all persons in second conditionals ('If I were you, I would apologize.').
explanation.vi: Câu điều kiện gồm mệnh đề 'if' (điều kiện) và mệnh đề chính (kết quả). Ở trình độ này, bạn cần nắm 3 loại chính: (1) Câu điều kiện loại 0 (ZERO) nói về sự thật chung, thói quen: If + thì hiện tại đơn, hiện tại đơn (If you heat ice, it melts) — kết quả luôn xảy ra. (2) Loại 1 (FIRST) nói về khả năng có thật trong tương lai: If + hiện tại đơn, will + động từ nguyên mẫu (If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home). Lưu ý: mệnh đề if KHÔNG dùng 'will'. (3) Loại 2 (SECOND) nói về tình huống giả định, không có thật hoặc khó xảy ra: If + quá khứ đơn, would + động từ nguyên mẫu (If I had more time, I would travel). Thì quá khứ ở đây diễn tả sự giả định, KHÔNG phải quá khứ — lỗi rất phổ biến của người Việt. Có thể đảo vị trí hai mệnh đề (We will stay home if it rains), nhưng chỉ dùng dấu phẩy khi mệnh đề if đứng trước. Ngoài ra: 'unless' = 'if... not' (Unless you hurry = If you don't hurry), và trong loại 2 thường dùng 'were' cho mọi ngôi (If I were you...).

common_mistakes.why: In the first conditional, the if-clause uses the present simple, not 'will'. 'Will' only appears in the result clause.
common_mistakes.right: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
common_mistakes.wrong: If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay home.

common_mistakes.why: In the second conditional (hypothetical situation), the result clause must use 'would + base verb', not 'will'. Mixing past simple with 'will' is a common error.
common_mistakes.right: If I had more money, I would buy a new phone.
common_mistakes.wrong: If I had more money, I will buy a new phone.
